colleges.name: Dalkhola College
colleges.description: Dalkhola's general degree college, known locally as Dalkhola College, offering undergraduate courses in arts and commerce.
facts: Official name is Shree Agrasen Mahavidyalaya; locals call it Dalkhola College or Agrasen College.
Started in 1995 because there was no higher-education institution within about 50 km.
Was first affiliated to the University of North Bengal before moving to the University of Gour Banga.
Honours courses include Bengali, Hindi, English, History, Political Science, Sociology and Accountancy, plus general arts and commerce streams.
NAAC-accredited and co-educational.
colleges.address: P.O. Dalkhola, Uttar Dinajpur, West Bengal 733201
colleges.image_alt: Main building of Shree Agrasen Mahavidyalaya, Dalkhola

schools.name: Dalkhola High School (H.S.)
schools.description: One of Dalkhola's oldest and largest schools, co-educational, teaching from class 5 up to class 12 (Higher Secondary).
facts: Began in 1947 as a Middle English School and was upgraded to a high school in 1950 with just six students in class VIII.
Reported enrolment is around 2,300 students (older figure; verify with the school).
The neighbourhood around it is known as High School Para, and High School More is a local landmark.
schools.address: High School Para, Dalkhola, West Bengal 733201
schools.image_alt: Dalkhola High School building, High School Para

schools.name: Dalkhola Girls High School
schools.description: Dalkhola Girls High School (H.S.) (DGHSS) is a Girls Only school in Dalkhola serving Dalkhola town, listed among the town's main high schools.
facts: Began in 1973 as a Middle School and was upgraded to an Upper Primary school in 1980 and Higher Secondary in 2007.
The medium of instruction is Bengali.
The School is located near the old Bus stand.
The School was previously adjacent to an Animal Hospital which now proposed to be a health center
schools.address: New Masjid Rd, near Shivam Complex, Dalkhola, West Bengal 733201

schools.name: Uttar Dalkhola High School (H.S.)
schools.description: Uttar Dalkhola High School is a government State Board co-educational school located in UTTAR DINAJPUR, West Bengal. Catering to students across a wide range of grade levels. Uttar Dalkhola High School is cmmitted to providing quality education and fostering the holistic development of every student.
facts: Established in 1987, the school has been serving the community for over 39 years
The medium of instruction is Bengali.It offers education from Class 5 to Class 12, catering to students across a wide range of grade levels
The School is located in the northern part of Dalkhola .
The School was previously adjacent to an Animal Hospital which now proposed to be a health center
schools.address: Hat Bari Rd, Dalkhola (M) - Ward No.11, Uttar Dinajpur West Bengal 733201

schools.name: Dalkhola Hindi High School
schools.description: HINDI HIGH SCHOOL DALKHOLA is Co-educational in type and it is Upper Primary and Secondary from class 5 to class 10 serving Dalkhola's Hindi-speaking community.
facts: Together with Bengali-medium schools, it reflects Dalkhola's mixed Bengali and Hindi-speaking population; the town was part of Bihar until 1959.
schools.address: Subhaspally, Dalkhola (M) - Ward No.8, Uttar Dinajpur West Bengal 733201

schools.name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Uttar Dinajpur (JNV Dalkhola)
schools.description: A free, co-educational residential school run by Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti for talented rural students, admitted through an entrance test.
facts: Founded in 2005 and part of the nationwide Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya network.
Motto: Pragyanam Brahma.
Has run from Teesta Colony, Dalkhola, next to the Primary Health Centre.
schools.address: Teesta Colony, Dalkhola, Uttar Dinajpur, West Bengal 733201

training_institutes.name: Coaching & Training at Dalkhola College (Shree Agrasen Mahavidyalaya)
training_institutes.description: The college has offered coaching to help students prepare for government service entry, along with remedial coaching for B.A. and B.Com. students.
facts: Coaching for service entry has been aimed at SC, ST and Minority-community students.
In 2004 the college ran a self-employment training programme for poor students under the RSVY scheme.
These details come from older descriptions of the college; confirm current programmes with the college office.
training_institutes.address: P.O. Dalkhola, Uttar Dinajpur, West Bengal 733201
